# excaliplant agent skill

This folder is generated from `skills-src/` by `node scripts/skills.mjs` and ships in the npm package. It follows the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io/specification) format.

- `excaliplant/` is the skill (`SKILL.md`, `references/`, `assets/`).
- `manifest.json` lists its files for `excaliplant skills install`.

Install it for your tools with `npx -y @grethel-labs/excaliplant skills install --tool all`, or see [docs/skills.md](../docs/skills.md) for every tool and for manual steps.
